messages.content: 如何烹飪五隻雞的食譜？

function.name: recipe_calculator_calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time to cook a recipe based on weight and per unit time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: The weight of the item to be cooked. This is a float type value.

per_unit_time.description: The time required to cook per unit weight.

unit_of_time.description: Unit of time, such as minutes or hours. Default is minutes.

We can give a general recipe for roasting five chickens. We might ask clarifying questions? But the instruction says we should respond with a recipe. We can give a simple roast chicken recipe scaled for five chickens. Provide ingredients, steps, cooking time. Also mention cooking time calculation using the function. We can use the function to calculate cooking time: weight of each chicken times per unit time. But we don't know weight. We can assume average weight of a whole chicken is about 1.5 kg. So total weight 7.5 kg. Per unit time maybe 20 minutes per kg. So cooking time 150 minutes. But we can also ask user for weight. But we can just provide a recipe.

We can also use the function to calculate time. Let's call the function with weight=7.5, per_unit_time=20, unit_of_time="minutes". That will return something. Then we can incorporate that into the recipe.
